name: APEX Wind Power Equipment Manufacturing
summary: Apex Wind Power Equipment Manufacturing Co., LTD. is a Taiwanese company specializing in the fabrication and supply of steel structures for offshore wind energy projects within Taiwan. Its product portfolio encompasses a range of specialized steel components, including standard, beveled, and pre-bent plates, as well as cylindrical cans, structural sections, and conical shapes. Established in 2018, the firm is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
